toolsPreview.name: SearchSaasTool
toolsPreview.description: Search the SaaS Browser database of 400k+ SaaS companies. Filter by category, technology, country, pricing, traffic, employees, age, and more. Returns up to 25 results with profile URLs.

toolsPreview.name: SearchCategoriesTool
toolsPreview.description: Search SaaS Browser categories by name or keyword. Returns matching category IDs for use with the SearchSaasTool category_ids filter.

toolsPreview.name: SearchTechnologiesTool
toolsPreview.description: Search SaaS Browser technologies by name or category. Returns matching technology IDs for use with the SearchSaasTool technology_ids filter.

toolsPreview.name: SearchAlternativesTool
toolsPreview.description: Find alternative/competing SaaS or software products for a given website host. Returns up to 25 published alternatives with profile URLs, descriptions, and names.
